question: What attainment makes a practitioner dear to the yoginīs?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation constitute a dual aim.
Great accomplishment can encompass both aims.
Such accomplishment can inspire affection from yoginīs.
inference: One who attains great accomplishment in both enjoyment and liberation may become dear to the yoginīs.
plain_english: One who has great accomplishment in both enjoyment and liberation may become dear to the yoginīs.
